resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; other codes with PBE and PAW support may be used
Pseudopotentials for PBE exchange-correlation functional; required for Sc, C, F

Lattice constant a = 3.294 Å, atomic positions of Sc₂CF₂ monolayer as described in the literature. Can be constructed from standard MXene geometry or taken from public structure databases (e.g., Materials Project). No external dataset required.
